Virginia: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Virginia on the map

Key dates

  • Early in-person voting: September 18, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Early voting ends at 5:00 p.m. on Saturday, October 31. Ask your local registrar's office for its locations and hours.
  • Voter registration deadline: October 23, 2026. You can register online, by mail (postmarked by this date) or in person. After October 23 you can still register in person and vote a provisional ballot through Election Day.
  • Last day to request a mailed absentee ballot: October 23, 2026. Requests are due by 5:00 p.m. Your ballot must be postmarked by Election Day and reach your registrar by the third day after the election.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. If you are in line at 7:00 p.m., you can still vote.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
